main_text.p: קצץ קץ Ch. Putavit, amputavit, abscidit, excidit, praecidit, succidit: Deinde Syr. Pactus est, Fedus iniit, feriit, Matth.20.2.13.&27.9. Ithpahel אתקצץ Abscidi, praescindi, amputari.
קַץ, קצא Chald. Finis, extremum, extremitas: scopus, terminus, Psalm. 78.9. Plural. emphat. קצַיָּא גְּנִיזַיָּא Fines, hoc est eventus occultos, Genef.49.1. in Targum Jonath.

קציצא Ch. Idem: בני קציצא חרא Filii finis unius, id est, quos conveniebat, vel qui debebant eodem tempore mori: Alii explicant, Filii sideris, fortunae ejusdem, Esth.1.3. in Targ.sec. Elias scripsit, se ignorare quid significet.
קיצאי, קיצאין Chald. Maxaupomoi, Germ. Messerschmid ut author Translationis Germanicae Judaeorum explicat, Esth.5.14.
קיצוצא Chald. Testudo, Lacerta, Levit.11.30. Jonath. Hebr. חומט.
קצר Ch. Abbreviare, decurtare, imminuere. Pahel קצר Idem. Ithpeh. אתקצר, Ithpah. אתקצר Abbreviari, decurtari, curtum, breve esse vel fieri.
קוצרא Ch. Brevis, curtus, Esth.7.10. in T. sec.
קצרא, קצר Ch. Fullo. Plur. קצרין.
ككא, קקתא Chal. Platea, Pelecanus, Levit.11.18. in Jon. Psal.102.7. Idem quod קתא.
קקבטון Chal. Panis calidus, לחם חם ut exponit author Aruch parvi, Genef.40.16. in Targum Hier. תלתא סלין דריפתא קקבטון Tres corbes panis calidi, recentis. Jon. רפיתא נקיא Panis candidi.

page.notes: Hebrew and Aramaic words are printed in Hebrew/Aramaic letters; the transcription of the vocalised and Syriac-looking forms is approximate and several are marked for doubt where the scan is faint.
